title: First-session funnel timestamps
description: Add and standardize fund and checkout funnel events with timestamp metadata for share/gift velocity metrics. Acceptance: New cohorts show valid median time_to_first_share and time_to_first_gift; no null fundId for fund-origin funnel events in normal flow.

title: Guided Launch completion telemetry
description: Emit step completion telemetry from Guided Launch and track 48h completion metric. Acceptance: Admin can report Guided Launch step drop-off and completion within 48h.

title: Checkout friction diagnostics by step
description: Track checkout step markers and abandonment before session creation. Acceptance: Admin diagnostics include step-level drop-offs and top abandonment step.

title: Lifecycle nudge queue to visible inbox
description: Surface lifecycle-generated activities with clear CTA actions in Activity feed/detail. Acceptance: Lifecycle activities are visible and actionable; no raw snake_case shown to users.

title: Pricing/entitlement consistency audit
description: Unify pricing and entitlement copy across app surfaces and validate overlap/grace states. Acceptance: No conflicting pricing copy; Starter->Family and Family->Starter states render correctly in Settings.

title: Fund details completeness in settings
description: Extend fund snapshot with recency fields strategy and coverage status plus empty-state guidance. Acceptance: Each fund card shows ownership and status without dashboard navigation.

title: Admin lifecycle signal cards and drill links
description: Add drill actions from lifecycle cards to relevant filtered admin views. Acceptance: Each lifecycle card links to a useful filtered context view.

title: Thank-you conversion loop scoring
description: Track thank-you action within seven days and expose trend in admin. Acceptance: Admin shows thank-you conversion and 7-day trend.

title: Share-after-gift prompt optimization
description: Run post-gift CTA variant test and measure CTR plus downstream checkout starts. Acceptance: Variant reporting exists and one winner is selected after threshold sample.

title: Event monetization decision clarity
description: Improve Event Boost vs Starter vs Family decision clarity and usage path. Acceptance: Multi-fund users understand best purchase path; support confusion decreases.

title: Unit economics trend panel
description: Add 30-day trends for revenue estimated store fees and contribution margin with confidence labels. Acceptance: Admin shows trend direction and confidence not only point-in-time values.

title: Retention reactivation outcomes
description: Track and report recovery conversion for no_gift_14d lifecycle signals. Acceptance: Admin shows reactivation recovery rate and sample count by channel where available.

title: Activity reliability hardening
description: Make activity enrichment resilient and prevent hard failures from relational gaps. Acceptance: Activity page remains functional with partial or missing relational data.

title: Outbound lifecycle worker
description: Build idempotent lifecycle nudge email worker with cooldown and suppression logic. Acceptance: Email nudges send once per cooldown window with safe retry/failure logs.

title: Fund health score
description: Compute and expose per-fund A/B/C health score with rationale drill-down. Acceptance: Admin fund table shows health score with explainable rationale.

title: Distribution source attribution model
description: Normalize source taxonomy and attribute fund creation plus first gift by source. Acceptance: Admin reports paid vs non-paid source contribution to first gifts and AFRG.

title: Guided Launch adaptive assistant
description: Adapt Guided Launch CTA copy by incomplete step and lifecycle state with resume behavior. Acceptance: Guided Launch completion lifts measurably vs baseline.

title: Weekly auto scorecard export
description: Automate weekly KPI scorecard artifact generation without manual SQL pulls. Acceptance: Weekly scorecard is generated automatically as CSV or JSON artifact.
